g.text: CEMS Analyzers: CO2, SO2, NOx (EPA CAMPD)
Custody Fuel Ledger & Substation Gross Load (MW)
Hardware Root of Trust / Secure Element
PrevHash chaining prevents packet drops & replay
• Computes binary commutative Keccak-256 Merkle Tree
Odd-Node Rule: Unpaired leaf promoted unchanged (DECISION-04)
Stores complete raw telemetry in local immutable archive
• Authorizes CEMS gateway public keys (65-byte SEC1 uncompressed)
• Handles cryptographic key rotation and emergency compromise revocation
• Enforces strict owner authentication and operator mapping
• Custodies Operator Bonds (min: 1.0 ETH) and Verifier Stakes (0.5 ETH)
• Enforces 7-day withdrawal lock delay preventing exit during disputes
• Slashing: 50% operator bond on fraud; 70% to verifiers, 30% treasury
• Conservation of funds invariant: totalDeposited == totalWithdrawable + slashed
• Records 32-byte Merkle root + sequence bounds (startSeq, endSeq)
• Measured gas: 179,843 gas median per anchorBatch transaction
• Two-Phase Commit-Reveal Quorum (5 independent committee slots)
• Phase 1: commitVote(keccak256(batchId, modelHash, inputHash, score, verdict, salt))
• Phase 2: revealVote(...) validates salt and checks modelHash match
• 3-of-5 matching verdicts required for quorum finality (0=Clean, 1=Fraud)
• Optimistic challenge window (24h prod, 60s testnet) upon Fraud quorum
• Operator submits Merkle counter-proof or dispute explanation
• Arbiter resolves dispute; triggers automated BondVault pull slashing
• Issues permanent CBAM Compliance Certificate upon Clean finalization
• Binds off-chain verification pack to on-chain Merkle roots
• One-click verification query for EU customs and authorised declarants
Checks Heat Input vs Independent Custody Fuel Ledger
Catches Variant A Adaptive Attacker (85.7% Recall)
Stoichiometric CO2 vs Heat Input ratio (R = CO2/Heat)
Gross Load MW vs Heat Input combustion envelope
Wiener spectral entropy (W=8) flags flatlining & noise injection
Lag-1 to Lag-4 autocorrelation catches synthetic loops
Physics reconstruction penalty; committed ONNX modelHash
Target FPR: 2.0% on clean validation split
Re-hashes packet; folds siblings against on-chain root in <5ms
